input.augmentation: existing data.py byte-identified geometry; no new copy-paste or class oversampling
input.feature_grid_interpretation: Keep ordinary bilinear align_corners=False. No claim of exact receptive-field-center equivalence between scales; no new grid_sample correction.

projection.native_initialization: copy P_G convolution and affine values without Parameter/storage aliases or RNG consumption; N buffers independently initialized

decoder.aux: crop_resize(FG720,256)->P_G using aux BN->K_G->G_spatial_BN using aux bank->ReLU->same_classifier; P_N,K_N,M not used

N.init: copy K_G and spatial BN affine values into independent parameters without RNG consumption

mixer.weights: M=[I64/2,I64/2] at initialization; unconstrained learnable thereafter

bn.affine: backbone G/N shared affine; P_G G/aux shared affine; K_G spatial BN G/aux shared affine; P_N and K_N spatial BN each own independent affine; no BN after M
bn.recompute: training batch statistics; no buffer or counter writes

main_loss.name: class_macro_batch_squared_dice
main_loss.if_class_gt_zero: 1-eps/(sum_valid(p*p)+eps); same Dice expression, no BCE fallback
main_loss.class_reduction: mean over exactly EX HE SE MA
main_loss.empty_class_supervision_limitation: epsilon-only gradient if both originals lack class; no claimed direct strong empty-class FP correction

aux_loss.name: original_per_valid_crop_per_class_squared_dice
aux_loss.filtering: drop fully ignored crop instances before aux head; keep all-background valid instances
aux_loss.reduction: mean over four classes then valid crop instances; no extra division by four
aux_loss.all_ignore_crops: zero aux loss and skip aux forward/BN update, retain valid main update
aux_loss.feature_box: divide all 2048-canvas box coordinates by 8, crop FG720 at 256 grid, then bilinear resize features to 256
aux_loss.logits_and_labels: bilinear resize auxiliary logits from 256 to crop_size in FP32; compare to unresized nearest-indexed label crop
aux_loss.aux_head_batch: concatenate all valid instances and call the aux head once; no per-crop head loop
aux_loss.rng: dedicated persistent numpy RandomState(42); save and restore its state

optimizer.parameter_groups: all trainable parameters exactly once; no multipliers
optimizer.clip_timing: after decoder and both encoder VJPs, before the one optimizer step

precision.autocast_scope: fresh context for each encoder forward, decoder forward and recompute; exit before backward; no enclosing autocast spanning no_grad and grad phases
precision.bn_input_calculation: disable autocast, calculate BN from FP32 input with FP32 affine and buffers, cast output back to incoming activation dtype
precision.feature_alignment_and_fusion: G feature interpolation FP32; concatenate float32 N/G then M and classifier under BF16 autocast(cache_enabled=False); ReLU after M; final logit interpolation FP32

recompute.initial_encoder_forward: no_grad but train BN, write each bank once
recompute.decoder_backward: feature leaves require gradients; preserve all leaf adjoints
recompute.encoder_vjp: recompute each view with identical parameters/input and suppressed BN buffer writes; accumulate J_G^T g_G + J_N^T g_N
recompute.bn_readonly_implementation: F.batch_norm with local clones of the current domain running buffers, training=True, momentum=0.1; discard clone writes and never increment persistent counter
recompute.no_grad_api: torch.no_grad only; not inference_mode; validate gradient ownership on recompute
recompute.gradient_ownership_check: check every expected trainable backbone parameter gradient; output.requires_grad alone is insufficient because BN affine can mask missing convolution gradients

evaluation.metric: global accumulated per-class TP FP FN then mean IoU; background excluded

evidence_status.decoder_reference_scope: CPU FP32 small feature grids only; full W48 and BF16 full-model validation remain pending

architecture_claims.contains_r3_prediction_family: not established; nonlinearities and spatial operators differ
architecture_claims.initial_prediction_identity: at aligned512 grid M=[I/2,I/2] gives exact mean of two branch logits under the shared classifier, in real arithmetic; not identity to old r3 or B0
architecture_claims.main_paths_receive_initial_gradient: M nonzero and K_G,K_N,classifier nonzero; conditional on ordinary nonzero upstream gradients/ReLU states
architecture_claims.encoder_aux_gradient: G view still propagates aux to shared W48; therefore N predictions can change after updates
architecture_claims.removed_restriction: G spatial decoder no longer forced to operate at512 grid; keep separate nonlinear branch representations before joint channel mixing
remaining_bottlenecks: no guarantee of useful cross-view diversity

design_review.design_candidate: selected r4; supersedes r3 for implementation
design_review.reason_execution_not_released: full implementation, initialization identity, complete W48 gradient/recompute equivalence and physical2048 batch2 memory remain to verify; no additional SGD for those checks
